name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the continuation aligns with the given context and incorporates the provided interesting fact effectively.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and consistency of the continuation within the context of the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is incoherent and 5 is highly coherent.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the continuation to capture and maintain the interest of the reader or listener.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging and 5 is highly engaging.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and inventiveness of the continuation, including the use of language and ideas.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not creative and 5 is highly creative.

name: Politeness
description: Measures the degree of courtesy and respectfulness in the continuation, considering the tone and manner of expression.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is impolite and 5 is very polite.

name: Clarity
description: Evaluates how clear and easily understandable the continuation is, including the use of language and sentence structure.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is unclear and 5 is very clear.

name: Informational Value
description: Measures the amount of useful or interesting information provided in the continuation beyond the given fact.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 provides no additional information and 5 provides substantial additional information.
